title: BoatLimiter
description: BoatLimiter prevents boat spam by limiting boat placement per radius and per chunk, including dispenser-based placement. Fully configurable, permission-based, and multilingual.
body:
## 🛥️ BoatLimiter

BoatLimiter is a plugin I created to stop excessive boat spam and the massive lag it can cause on servers.

The main reason for this was a common problem: players building so-called **elytra launchers**, where hundreds of boats get stacked into one spot using dispensers. This can easily drop your server’s TPS down to **0** within seconds. That’s exactly what BoatLimiter is designed to prevent.

With this plugin, you can control how many boats are allowed in a small area (radius) and per chunk — no matter if they’re placed by players or automatically through dispensers or droppers.

It’s easy to set up, simple to configure, and works right away without needing anything else.

---

## ✨ Features

- Limit how many boats can be placed in a certain radius  
- Limit how many boats are allowed per chunk  
- Stops players and machines from stacking boats in one spot  
- Fully configurable via `config.yml`  
- Can be enabled or disabled per world  
- Logs blocked actions (with built-in anti-spam)  
- Includes a small stats system to track abuse  
- Detailed permission & bypass system  
- Supports English & German (with fallback)  
- Works perfectly with LuckPerms  
- Made for real server use  

---

⚠️ **Dispenser & Dropper Protection**

BoatLimiter also handles boat spam coming from:

- Dispensers  
- Droppers  
- Redstone builds using dispensers  

> Important: This plugin does **not** break normal redstone.  
> It only limits boat placement from dispensers and droppers.

---

## ⚙️ Commands

- `/boatlimiter reload` – Reload the config  
- `/boatlimiter stats` – Show stats about blocked actions  
- `/boatlimiter clearchunk` – Remove all boats in the current chunk  

---

## 🔐 Permissions

- `boatlimiter.bypass` – Ignore all limits  
- `boatlimiter.bypass.radius` – Ignore radius limit  
- `boatlimiter.bypass.chunk` – Ignore chunk limit  
- `boatlimiter.reload` – Reload the config  
- `boatlimiter.stats` – View stats  
- `boatlimiter.clearchunk` – Clear boats in the current chunk  

---
